method: Every page in site.json, urls.txt and the live sitemap.xml (71 pages), 1 request per second, Chrome user agent. Every /s/ link was then checked with HEAD; the Squarespace redirect target carries the upload time in milliseconds, which is how new and replaced files were told apart.
